app.name: DISHA
app.demoNotice: Demonstration Prototype for Overcrowded Government Hospitals
app.offlineNotice: You're offline. Saved hospital directions are available.

landing.heroSubtitle: Find your way, track your queue, and complete your hospital visit independently in your preferred language.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Designed for elderly citizens and first-time hospital visitors with zero confusion.
landing.step1Desc: Choose your language and purpose. No sensitive Aadhaar data required.
landing.step2Desc: Turn-by-turn guidance, elevator routes, and checkpoint QR verification.
landing.step3Desc: Track patients ahead and estimated wait times in real time.
landing.step4Desc: Seamless transition from doctor consultation to lab tests and free pharmacy.
landing.feat1Desc: Full translation in Hindi, Punjabi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, and English.
landing.feat2Desc: Dijkstra algorithm automatically routes around staircases using ramps and lifts.
landing.feat3Desc: Speaks directions aloud and listens to simple natural voice commands.
landing.feat4Desc: Share a temporary private status link with worried family members.
landing.feat5Desc: Maps and instructions stay accessible even when hospital network drops.
landing.feat6Desc: Live crowd levels prevent corridor jamming and guide waiting patients.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Hospital Visit Assistant
onboarding.purposeDesc: We'll set up your personalized route and queue tokens.
onboarding.optionalInfoDesc: All fields are optional. Continue as a guest anytime.

dashboard.estimatedNote: Waiting times are dynamic estimates based on doctor consultations.
dashboard.smartWaitText: You have approx. {{mins}} mins. Nearby drinking water and accessible restrooms are 40m away.

navigation.title: Indoor Hospital Navigation
navigation.scanCheckpointDesc: Scan a wall QR code in the corridor to automatically update your location.

queue.title: Live Queue Status
queue.recoveryDesc: If you missed your token call, you can request hospital reception to reinstate your token.
queue.alert2Ahead: Only 2 patients ahead! Please stay near the room.
queue.alertCalled: YOUR TOKEN HAS BEEN CALLED! Please proceed to {{counter}}.

journey.title: Patient Journey Roadmap
journey.subtitle: Track and manage each stage of your hospital visit.

voice.title: DISHA Voice Assistant
voice.commandsHint: Try saying: 'Where is the pharmacy?', 'What is my token number?', 'How long is my wait?', 'Where is the laboratory?'
voice.notSupported: Voice recognition is not supported in this browser. Quick buttons are available.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Options
accessibility.simpleModeDesc: Hides complex menus and displays only 4 large buttons for your next stop, token, voice, and help.

facilities.title: Hospital Facility Finder
facilities.searchPlaceholder: Search for water, toilets, lifts, canteen, emergency...

caregiver.title: Caregiver Connect
caregiver.subtitle: Share your live queue and journey status with family members via a safe, temporary link.
caregiver.privacyNote: For your privacy, clinical diagnosis and medical records are never shared.
caregiver.activeNotice: Caregiver link is active for 12 hours.
